title: Kani Avocado Temaki
description: Fresh nori cones with crab stick, avocado, lettuce and cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Drain and shred crab sticks, then lightly mix with Kewpie. Slice avocado, cucumber and dried lettuce into strips.
Cut whole nori sheets in half to make cone-sized pieces.
Spread a little rice diagonally across each half-sheet. Add lettuce, avocado, cucumber and crab mixture; wrap into cones.
Eat immediately while the nori is crisp.
notes: Approximately eight cones for six light servings.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
